newsitem.title: USA: COMEX copper called to open slightly higher.
newsitem.headline: COMEX copper called to open slightly higher.

text.p: COMEX copper futures were called to open slightly higher Thursday as overnight dealings on LME maintained late Wednesday's gains.
COMEX September copper was called 0.20 to 0.30 cent firmer from Wednesday's close of 111.90 cents a lb. It traded between 112.45 and 111.10 cents on ACCESS.
LME copper stocks rose a modest 425 tonnes Thursday to 130,500 tonnes.
Wednesday, COMEX warehouse copper stocks fell 1,160 short tons to 43,586 short tons.
The LME cash to three months backwardation widened overnight to $160/$170 a tonne, up from $145/$155 at COMEX close Wednesday.
Continuing rains have enabled Ok Tedi copper mine in Papua New Guinea to maintain shipments of copper concentrates on the Fly River this week, a spokesman for the mine operator BHP Ltd said Thursday.
